hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*) ;; *.ts|*.tsx) deno fmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *.css) deno run -A npm:stylelint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; deno fmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
